failure: Fresh installation hides Start SceneZOI on controlled characters and supported furniture.
cause: Native cfg_load rejects an absent selection_request key. The receiver cached host identity before reading the request and acknowledging readiness, so initial failure permanently skipped the handshake.
masked_by: Existing development configuration already contained the request key. The former UI fixture returned an empty successful value for absent keys.
fixes: Initialize the absent request mailbox before publishing native host readiness.
Commit receiver host identity and the ignored boot request only after the readiness acknowledgement succeeds.
Serialize receiver polling and retry the same host after read/write failures.

regressions: Empty runtime configuration creates the request mailbox before host readiness.
Native-style missing-key responses are modeled as failures.
One failed request read or readiness write retries and still ignores the stale boot request.

author_acceptance.report: It is working after the exact 1.0.1 ZIP was installed into a fresh directory and the game restarted.

artifacts.source_snapshot_note: Corresponding source was captured at package build time, before this final acceptance update. Runtime/UI source bytes are unchanged.
artifacts.hzoi: Existing HZoi 1.0 remains unchanged and compatible.
